# Solution: ACK-Managed S3 Logs Bucket

I'll add a new logs bucket to both environments with versioning, encryption, blocked public access, and appropriate IAM permissions.

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-dev
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicACLs: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicACLs: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/iam.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: User
metadata:
  name: myapp-sa-dev
spec:
  userName: myapp-sa-dev

---

apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-sa-policy-dev
spec:
  policyName: myapp-sa-policy-dev
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-dev/*"
        },
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
  userRef:
    name: myapp-sa-dev
```

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-prod
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicACLs: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicACLs: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/iam.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-sa-role-prod
spec:
  roleName: myapp-sa-role-prod
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {
            "Service": "eks.amazonaws.com"
          },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
        }
      ]
    }

---

apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-sa-policy-prod
spec:
  policyName: myapp-sa-policy-prod
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-prod/*"
        },
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
  roleRef:
    name: myapp-sa-role-prod
```

---

**Changes summary:**
- **Buckets:** Each environment gets a versioned, encrypted, fully-private S3 bucket for logs (`myapp-logs-{env}`)
- **IAM:** Updated the Policy resources in each environment to add `s3:GetObject` and `s3:PutObject` permissions scoped only to the new logs buckets, without altering access to existing assets buckets
- **Isolation:** All changes are environment-specific; `kubectl apply -f dev/` and `kubectl apply -f prod/` remain fully independent
